story_text: As a user, I want to create a task with only a title and no optional fields so that minimal input is sufficient.

positive.title: Create task with only a title — all optional fields omitted
steps: 1. Send a POST request to the /tasks endpoint with a JSON body containing only the title field.
positive.expected_result: 201 Created (defaults applied for omitted optional fields)

positive.title: Verify defaults are applied for omitted optional fields
steps: 1. Send a POST request to the /tasks endpoint with a JSON body containing only the title field.
2. Verify that the response status code is 201 Created.
3. Verify that the response body contains the default values for the omitted optional fields.
positive.expected_result: 201 Created (defaults applied for omitted optional fields)

positive.title: Create task with title and one optional field
steps: 1. Send a POST request to the /tasks endpoint with a JSON body containing the title and one optional field.
2. Verify that the response status code is 201 Created.
3. Verify that the response body contains the value for the specified optional field.

negative.title: Create task without a title — title is a required field
steps: 1. Send a POST request to the /tasks endpoint with a JSON body containing no title field.
2. Verify that the response status code is 400 Bad Request.
3. Verify that the response body contains a descriptive error message.
negative.expected_result: 400 Bad Request (title is a required field)

edge.title: Create task with extra/unknown fields in the body
steps: 1. Send a POST request to the /tasks endpoint with a JSON body containing the title field and additional unknown fields.
2. Verify that the response status code is 201 Created.
3. Verify that the response body contains the created task with the title field and ignores the unknown fields.

edge.title: Create task with title that is the maximum allowed length
steps: 1. Send a POST request to the /tasks endpoint with a JSON body containing the title field with the maximum allowed length.
2. Verify that the response status code is 201 Created.
3. Verify that the response body contains the created task with the title field.
edge.expected_result: 201 Created (defaults applied for all optional fields)

edge.title: Create task with title that exceeds maximum allowed length
steps: 1. Send a POST request to the /tasks endpoint with a JSON body containing the title field with a length that exceeds the maximum allowed.
2. Verify that the response status code is 400 Bad Request.
3. Verify that the response body contains a descriptive error message.
